workload.source: written here from the benchmark in the description of https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/25547 (WAL replay of many BEGIN; INSERT; COMMIT transactions with checkpoints off): opening a database whose WAL holds 20,000 one-row transactions, built by eval/tasks/workloads/duckdb-duckdb-pr25547/make_wal.py; read-only, so the WAL is replayed on every open and never checkpointed away
